title: Outstanding Sweet Turkish Turkish Delight Pudding
description: A sweet and bouncy Turkish dessert featuring Turkish Delight, made in a kadhai and suitable for kids, this pudding is a delicious and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly treat.
instructions: Combine milk, sugar, and cornstarch in a kadhai and whisk until the cornstarch is dissolved.
Cook the mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the mixture thickens.
Remove the kadhai from the heat and stir in the diced Turkish Delight, rose water, and cardamom powder.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then pound it in a mortar and pestle until it is well combined and the Turkish Delight is fully incorporated.
Stir in the ghee until it is fully incorporated and the pudding is smooth.
Pour the pudding into individual serving cups and refrigerate until chilled.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional diced Turkish Delight if desired.
